title: MODFLOW6 Prepared-Solve Iterative Backend

canonical_reconciliation.head: 7b864853ca22baa73141b2dec9ed2f3915ef520d
canonical_reconciliation.impact: Canonical did not move during final F-GC38 qualification. Existing active-drainage tangent changes are orthogonal to this MODFLOW lifecycle/backend qualification.

source_evidence.lifecycle: MODFLOW XMI explicitly supports external nonlinear exchange between repeated solve calls inside one prepare_solve/finalize_solve pair.
source_evidence.accepted_origin: Normal prepare_solve copies X to XOLD once; repeated solve calls evolve X while XOLD remains the previous-time accepted head.

qualified_contract: backend sits below the internal SWAP5-MODFLOW coupling service; iMOD Coupler owns no predictor/corrector science
one prepare_solve per coupled groundwater window
fixed XOLD through all externally driven nonlinear solve iterations
current X evolves between solve calls
F-GC34 terms may be republished between successive MODFLOW solve calls
live IMS MXITER is read from SLN_<solution_id> and enforced before another solve call
attempting a solve beyond MXITER fails closed without invoking kernel.solve
abandoned/nonconverged prepared solve is invalidated and is not reusable as accepted groundwater state

live_test.head: fc8f750fa900beb083849b0100db6e510e66e190
live_test.model_envelope: transient 1-layer 1-row 3-column convertible NEWTON GWF with STO, two CHD end cells, one API package on middle cell
live_test.path_equivalence_rule: sqrt(float64 machine epsilon) * max(1 m, head scale)

qualification_history.disposition: Initial live prepared-solve route passed lifecycle/origin checks; clean-path equality threshold was too strict for independent nonlinear solve paths.
Measured exact A-B-C versus clean-C path spread as 3.7603209435133067e-10 m.
Continuing final response beyond first convergence flag stabilized each path below 5e-13 m while preserving the small inter-path spread.
Overly strict IMS criteria exposed unsafe caller overrun of MODFLOW outer iteration envelope; this motivated explicit MXITER guarding.
With explicit MXITER guard, extremely strict criteria failed boundedly instead of overrunning libmf6.
Isolated rclose=1e-12 was rejected because a fresh clean reference did not report convergence within the solver budget.

qualified: live repeated F-GC34 republishing between solve iterations
numerical path equivalence for the qualified transient NPF+STO+API envelope
not_yet_qualified: whole-window MODFLOW rollback/reconstruction after abandoned prepared solve
real SWAP5 corrector plus live MODFLOW prepared-solve end-to-end coupling service

exclusions: MODFLOW ATS as external rollback API
next_permitted_action: Reconcile F-GC37 groundwater-participant semantics to one prepared MODFLOW solve session with fixed XOLD and evolving X, while preserving transactional same-origin SWAP correctors and keeping whole-window retry/reconstruction separate.
